To add a property type: transcribe the 100-row lookup table from the EPA technical reference for that type (Multifamily Housing first per decision c, then Office), record the EPA model version, and add a golden test that pins at least three score↔ratio pairs from the published table.

The ratio is actual ÷ predicted source EUI. Because the predicted EUI depends only on the building's operating characteristics, the source-EUI reduction needed to move from score s1 to s2 is 1 − ratio(s2) ÷ ratio(s1).
